question: By what positional claim is this chapter identified in relation to its origin from Candradvīpa?
premises: This chapter is said to have emerged from Candradvīpa.
Its position is counted in sequence from that origin.
It is designated as the fifth in that sequence.
inference: The fifth chapter is the one that emerged from Candradvīpa.
plain_english: The fifth chapter is the one that emerged from Candradvīpa.
